entities.summary: Carter Lewis Capps is an American former professional baseball pitcher and coach. Capps played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Diego Padres, Seattle Mariners, and Miami Marlins from 2012 to 2017. After his playing career, he worked as a pitching coach.
